item.title: Ohio Republicans face a deadline as Rep. Max Miller rejects calls to step aside
item.description: Ohio Congressman Max Miller says he's staying in his reelection race despite abuse allegations. His former father-in-law, US Sen. Bernie Moreno, says Miller should step aside before next week's ballot deadline.
item.content:encoded: Ohio Congressman Max Miller says he's staying in his reelection race despite abuse allegations. His former father-in-law, US Sen. Bernie Moreno, says Miller should step aside before next week's ballot deadline.

item.title: Rural California school district creates space where kids can learn to swim
item.description: Not everyone has access to a public pool. But a rural school district in California just pulled together funding for a new aquatic center so kids can learn to swim.
item.content:encoded: Not everyone has access to a public pool. But a rural school district in California just pulled together funding for a new aquatic center so kids can learn to swim.

item.title: Todd Blanche's nomination back on track after GOP deal
item.description: Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination is moving forward after two Republican senators received written assurances the Justice Department would abandon a controversial compensation fund.

item.title: Wildfires near Spokane have burned thousands of acres and displaced many more
item.description: Wildfires near Spokane, Wash., have burned at least 7,000 acres, destroyed hundreds of homes and forced the evacuation of tens of thousands of people.

item.title: What Cambodia did right about preventing HIV
item.description: The height of the AIDS epidemic hit Cambodia in the late 90s. More than 180,000 people were infected. A full-on government effort to find at-risk populations and distribute medication has gotten the spread under control.
item.content:encoded: The height of the AIDS epidemic hit Cambodia in the late 90s. More than 180,000 people were infected. A full-on government effort to find at-risk populations and distribute medication has gotten the spread under control.

item.title: Climate change is changing how Texas farmers handle their peach harvests
item.description: Texas experienced its warmest winter on record since 1895 and the state's farmers say those high temperatures hampered their peach harvest.

item.title: Megan Rapinoe says next year's Women's World Cup "is going to be lit"
item.description: Missing the World Cup? Well the 2027 Women's World Cup is just around the corner. Host Juana Summers talks about that with former US national team star Megan Rapinoe.

item.description: Dozens of people who grew up around Philadelphia learned decades later they shared the same biological father, a pioneering infertility doctor.

item.title: The largest human composting facility is coming to Maryland
item.description: The largest human composting facility in the nation is soon opening in Maryland, with capacity to handle 2,000 bodies a year. It's meeting a growing demand for eco-friendly interment options.
